title: Value Alignment Tax: Measuring Value Trade-offs in LLM Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures normative judgments and value trade-offs in social scenarios related to religion, as one of several social topics. It does not measure bias, knowledge, or stereotypes, but rather how alignment interventions reshape an LLM's value system in contexts including religion.
findings: The paper does not report findings specific to the topic of religion. The results are aggregated and analyzed based on the value dimensions being steered (e.g., Security, Power) and the alignment methods used, rather than being broken down by the social topic of the scenario.
